$comment: Fastboot device profiles (VID/PID whitelist) for FirmwareKit.Comm.Fastboot. Load with UsbManager.LoadDeviceProfilesFromFile() or copy entries into UsbManager.KnownDeviceProfiles. Used as a discovery fallback for devices whose interface descriptor is not the standard fastboot interface (0xff/0x42/0x03). productId may be null to match any product under the vendor.

profiles.name: Google (Android/AOSP)
profiles.note: Standard fastboot interface; found by interface filter. Listed for reference.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: fastboot mode via adb reboot bootloader or key combo

profiles.name: Amazon Kindle Fire (stock bootloader)
profiles.note: Non-standard fastboot interface in some firmware revisions; needs VID/PID fallback.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: Fastboot cable (factory cable) or bootmode 4002 via oem idme
knownLimitations: Requires fastboot cable or bootmode manipulation

profiles.name: Fuzhou Rockchip Electronics (U-Boot fastboot)
profiles.note: U-Boot fastboot gadget on RK3xxx/RK2xxx dev boards (e.g. NanoPi, Rock Pi). MaskROM/rockusb mode is a different protocol, not fastboot.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: fastboot 0 in U-Boot console, or adb reboot fastboot on Android builds
knownLimitations: MaskROM mode (0x2207:0x330c etc.) is rockusb protocol, NOT fastboot

profiles.name: Allwinner Technology (U-Boot fastboot)
profiles.note: U-Boot fastboot gadget on Orange Pi, Banana Pi and other Allwinner boards.

profiles.name: Amlogic (U-Boot fastboot)
profiles.note: Amlogic S9xx/G12x dev boxes and boards with U-Boot fastboot.

profiles.name: Raspberry Pi (U-Boot fastboot over USB/TCP)
profiles.note: Raspberry Pi with U-Boot fastboot; VID may vary, often reachable via TCP/UDP network fastboot.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: fastboot usb 0 or fastboot tcp in U-Boot console

profiles.name: Huawei / Honor (HarmonyOS/Android fastboot)
profiles.note: Fastboot mode on Huawei/Honor phones, tablets and HarmonyOS NEXT devices. HDB/hdc (0x12D1:0x5501 etc.) is a separate debugging protocol.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: Volume down + power (varies by model); adb reboot bootloader on Android builds
knownLimitations: Some models require signed fastboot images

profiles.name: Samsung (Android fastboot / Odin)
profiles.note: Samsung fastboot on some models; Odin mode is a separate protocol.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: Volume down + power + home (Odin), or fastboot on supported models
knownLimitations: Many Samsung devices use Odin, not fastboot

profiles.name: Xiaomi / Redmi (Android fastboot)
profiles.note: Xiaomi fastboot mode; standard interface on most models.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: Volume down + power, or adb reboot bootloader

profiles.name: OPPO / OnePlus / Realme (Android fastboot)
profiles.note: OnePlus/OPPO/Realme fastboot; OnePlus historically uses 0x22D9 or Google VID.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: Volume down + power, or adb reboot bootloader

profiles.name: vivo / iQOO (Android fastboot)
profiles.bootloaderEntry: Volume up + power, or adb reboot bootloader

profiles.name: Generic U-Boot board (custom VID)
profiles.note: U-Boot builds expose CONFIG_USB_GADGET_VENDOR_NUM/PRODUCT_NUM. Add the exact VID/PID of your board here, or use fastboot -i <VID>.
profiles.bootloaderEntry: fastboot usb 0 / fastboot udp in U-Boot console
